ICS: Deliver bad news paying attention to the patient’s/family’s level of understanding.
Counsel patient and family to aid understanding of treatment plan in a simplified and understandable manner.
Demonstrate empathy towards patient’s and family’s problems and attempt to provide solutions while taking their circumstances and cultural beliefs into account.
Discuss the diagnosis and overall treatment plan.
Engage the patient and family in a discussion about their personal and cultural beliefs
Be prepared to discuss psychosocial challenges an immigrant family may be facing
